metadata.description: Secret-safe contract for a restricted PostgreSQL backup, isolated restore rehearsal and bounded parity evidence before a staging upgrade.

truthRequirements.backup.verified: A non-empty PostgreSQL custom-format dump exists in mode 0600 custody and has a SHA-256 digest.
truthRequirements.restore.verified: The dump was restored into an isolated matching PostgreSQL container with no network and tmpfs storage.
truthRequirements.parity.verified: The bounded source and restored PostgreSQL inventories are structurally equal.
truthRequirements.coverage.unverified: Must be empty for the required coverage set; unimplemented backends must never be silently promoted to verified.
